services.name: Education Programs
services.desc: SRM Summer Camp is always great fun! Join us at the Southeastern Railway Museum for our Classic Trains Summer Camp, July 13-17 from 9AM -1PM. Designed for kids ages 5-12, this fun-filled week brings history to life with five legendary trains: The sleek Pioneer Zephyr of the Chicago, Burlington & Quincy RR. The luxurious 20th Century Limited: Campers will enjoy railroad adventures, hands-on crafts, engaging lessons, games, and more - plus the chance to explore the museum up close! Did we mention train rides? There’s no excuse for your child’s summer blues. Fuel their curiosityand let their imagination ride the rails. Save with June early registration good through May 3!
